constructions.latent_object: S({p,q}) = sum_{x in {p,q}} K(x), where K(x)=V(x)^2*G0(x)

hypotheses.construction_plan: Substitute theta=p and theta=q into the common kernel K(theta)=V(theta)^2*G0(theta). Under commutativity, each instantiation matches one summand of the original expression.
required_assumptions: Multiplication is commutative for the symbolic factors in each summand.
V and G0 are univariate functions or at least accept a single argument.
hypotheses.rationale: The two summands are identical up to renaming the free variable p/q, so they are substitution instances of a single univariate kernel V(x)^2*G0(x). This explains FAMILY F01 and the repeated V and G0 applications.

hypotheses.latent_object: S({p,q}) = sum_{x in {p,q}} K(x), where K(x)=V(x)^2*G0(x)
hypotheses.construction_plan: Represent the full expression as a two-point sum of a univariate kernel K(x)=V(x)^2*G0(x), with the summation variable ranging over the set {p,q}.
required_assumptions: The variable set is finite and consists of the two declared free symbols p and q.
hypotheses.rationale: The raw expression is a repeated evaluation of a common kernel at two distinct free variables; this is a structural repetition pattern rather than an arbitrary simplification.
